title: BTS
description: South Korean boy band formed in 2013 under Big Hit Entertainment (now HYBE). Consisting of 7 members, BTS became a global phenomenon and one of the best-selling music acts in history, known for their socially conscious lyrics and powerful performances.

title: BLACKPINK
description: South Korean girl group formed in 2016 by YG Entertainment. Consisting of 4 members, BLACKPINK became one of the most followed music acts on social media and the highest-charting female Korean act on the Billboard Hot 100.

title: NewJeans
description: South Korean girl group formed in 2022 under ADOR (HYBE subsidiary). Consisting of 5 members, NewJeans gained rapid popularity for their retro-inspired sound and minimalist aesthetic, winning multiple Rookie of the Year awards.
